ITM
Internal Transfer Memo: material sent from one project, or the warehouse, to another project. It has no vendor and no payments.
Material Usage
A project tab that lists, per item, what was ordered, delivered, challaned and inspected.
Ordered Qty
What the project has asked for. With this PR: PO quantity plus the quantity of incoming ITMs at status Approved or later.
Delivery Note Qty
What has arrived on site, from POs and ITMs together.
DC / MIR
Delivery Challan (the paper that comes with a delivery) and Material Inspection Report (the site's check of it).
PO/ITM Wise
The Material Usage view with one row per PO or ITM, renamed from PO Wise by this PR.
Fully Paid / Unpaid on an ITM
An ITM has no payments. This PR shows it as Fully Paid once Delivered and Unpaid before that.
WO
Work Order: an order for services from a vendor. Older screens and ids call it a Service Request (SR).
MTC
Material Test Certificate: the maker's test report for material on a PO, uploaded on the PO page.
PM / PL
Project Manager and Project Lead. With this PR they may upload MTCs on their own projects' POs.
Non-Billable PO
A PO whose cost is not billed to the client. MTCs apply to Billable POs only.
Revised PO Date
The date the latest Approved PO Revision was approved. With this PR it replaces PO Date on a revised PO's preview and PDFs.
MSME / Udyam
A government registration for small businesses. The Udyam certificate carries the MSME ID, for example UDYAM-KR-03-0097422.
Gemini
The AI service that reads an uploaded certificate. The test envs have no key for it, so the read always fails there.
Before / After
Before is the code the PR starts from (develop at 42313959a). After is the PR's own code (3d2a323c4).
Role check
A test that one role sees, or does not see, what the PR says it should.
Must / Should / Nit / Note
How serious a pinned point is: must fix before merge, should fix, small polish, or just worth knowing.
